item.title: Merkos Chinuch Office to Host Two-Part Chinuch Training
item.description: The Merkos Chinuch Office will be hosting a two-part Chinuch program designed to accommodate both morning and afternoon Mechanchos so they can attend when not teaching, as well as Mechanchos and Menahalos who are in town for the Kinus Hashluchos. Each part addresses the same core ideas and chinuch goals. Full Story

item.title: Siyum HaRambam Spurs Global Dive Into Hilchos Moshiach
item.description: On 15 Iyar, 5751, the Rebbe stood outside 770 and handed each chossid a booklet titled Dvar Malchus. Inside were four sichos on the Rambam’s Hilchos Moshiach — halachos that, in the Rebbe’s words, contain “clear directives for our generation.” As the once-in-three-year Siyum HaRambam arrives this Monday, that booklet is once again front and center. Full Story

item.title: Jewish Leaders Meet Saudi Defense Minister in Washington
item.description: Several leading Jewish and pro-Israel organizations met behind closed doors on Friday afternoon in Washington with Saudi Arabia’s defense minister Khalid bin Salman, the brother of Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, in a closely watched gathering that concluded shortly before the onset of Shabbos.
